# Code of conduct

English · [简体中文](../docs/zh-CN/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

We are committed to a friendly, professional, harassment-free collaboration environment regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, experience, nationality, appearance, religion, or sexual orientation.

Participants must:

- Respect different perspectives and discuss facts, code, and user impact.
- Provide reproducible information and receive constructive feedback professionally.
- Avoid insults, harassment, threats, privacy violations, and unsolicited promotion.
- Stop amplifying misconduct and report it through the private maintainer channel.

Maintainers may edit or remove comments, commits, and issues that violate this policy and may warn, temporarily restrict, or permanently ban participants according to severity. Enforcement decisions should be explained unless doing so would harm a reporter or expose private information.

The repository owner must add a real private conduct-reporting channel before public launch.
